about: What each guild hall adds to the decisions, from Denning (2026-11-10) and the Guild Wars Wiki. Label ids point into data/maps/labels/<map id>.json. footmen = labelled footmen per side (0: the team cannot fall to footmen, R-310). fall_back = where a retreating team can fall, in order. family = the decision family of docs/REDESIGN.md. The engine does not read this yet (REDESIGN.md step 2). Checked by tools/maps/audit_labels.py. A route drawn through a teleporter carries drawn_length and walked_length: the hop cannot be drawn with no length, so it is taken out (R-316).

effects.name: Miasma
effects.what: 5 pips of health degeneration, cannot be removed, spreads to adjacent creatures

objects.obelisk flag stand: turns the beach statues' Fireballs on the team not holding it; almost never used (R-308), not modelled

teleporters.note: one way: in beside the Guild Lord, out on the main field (R-309)

effects.name: Fount Of Maguuma
effects.what: +1 health regeneration while standing in the water around the flag stand

vine seed spawn.what: where each team's vine seed spawns, inside its base (confirmed by Denning)

vine seed drop spot.what: where the seed is capped to grow the vine bridge; until then that way is blocked and the base has one way in and out (confirmed by Denning)

flag_routes.name: over the vine
flag_routes.open: only once that team's vine seed is capped

decisions.what: cap the vine seed or not (opens a second way out of the base, for the flag and for splits, and a second way in)
run the flag the long way or over the vine (about 1,600 units shorter as drawn, through two choke points, and only with the seed capped)

execution.what: not standing in the healing water while the team is around the flag stand is a micro mistake

effects.name: Spiked Coral
effects.what: 10% slower and 25 damage each second while moving

teleporters.note: two teleporters, either team, either direction; the usual way out for a split and for the back door, and a way to collapse

flag_routes.name: over the coral
flag_routes.cost: coral damage and more exposure to the enemy team
flag_routes.note: drawn through a teleporter: the hop (about 4,700 units) is not walked (R-316)

decisions.what: run the flag over the bridge (longer, safer) or over the coral (shorter, takes coral damage, more exposed)
split, back door and collapse usually go through the teleporter

effects.name: Blessed Water
effects.what: standing in water gives Blessed Water (the hall page gives no numbers)

effects.name: Stone Spores
effects.what: 33% less damage and healing and -2 to all attributes for 10 seconds, near the giant mushrooms; always on in PvP

gate.what: the one direct link between the main path and the split path, facing the flag stand

gate lock.what: opens the gate; it can only be reached from the back (split) side (Denning, R-315)

decisions.what: the gate opens only from the back side, so gate control belongs to whoever holds the back side: a team that has it can collapse on a split through the gate, and a split that has it can collapse on the main team the same way

355.as_in_game_note: one outer archer a side does not mirror: as it stands in the game (Denning, R-318)

effects.name: Quicksand
effects.what: 15% slower, and 1 Energy lost on every attack or skill

teleporters.note: one to each base from outside the quicksand, either team, either direction; the back door is usually a split out the teleporter

decisions.what: split out through the teleporter (the usual back door)

effects.name: Acid Trap
effects.what: 20 armor-ignoring earth damage each second, in the corridor where the flags spawn

teleporters.note: one way, to the far side of the flag stand; a carried flag is not dropped (wiki)

flag_routes.name: short way
flag_routes.cost: can be body blocked; runs straight into the enemy team

decisions.what: run the flag the short way (body blocks, straight into the enemy) or the long, safe way

effects.name: Trebuchet
effects.what: the ground a trebuchet hits when fired; 707 fire damage against 60 armor (wiki)

repair kit.what: labelled Repair kit (one a side, the markers nearest the flag stand; confirmed by Denning). Carried to a trebuchet's lever to repair it

trebuchet.what: labelled Trebuchet (the two outer markers; confirmed by Denning). Once repaired: pull the lever to load, again to fire

decisions.what: run the team's own repair kit back to its base, so the enemy cannot repair the trebuchet aimed at it
run the repair kit to the enemy's trebuchet to capture it
push for the enemy's repair kit while it has not been taken to safety, to steal it and capture their trebuchet

notes: Front door and back door are largely the same paths: each has two ways out of the base of about equal length that end in about the same place. The real difference is that the back door (usually the split side) runs over the bridge.
Two flag paths, not a decision: both end in about the same place.
One bridge, crossed by both sides' back doors (confirmed by Denning).

health shrine.what: labelled Health shrine. +120 maximum Health to every member of the team holding it; captured like an Alliance Battle shrine (wiki)

decisions.what: fight for, capture or split for the health shrine, paid for with a numbers disadvantage or a flag disadvantage elsewhere

effects.name: Icy Ground
effects.what: a creature standing still on the ice moves 70% slower for 5 seconds (checked every 2 seconds; no effect while already moving)

gates.what: two on each side; when one of a side's gates is open the other is closed

gate levers.what: one for each side's pair of gates, on the dais in the middle

decisions.what: defend or control the gate levers
split through the bridge gates or around the back

effects.name: Lava
effects.what: Crippled and Burning every 3 seconds while standing in it

lesser flame sentinels.what: labelled Flame sentinel. Hostile to both teams, on the lava route between the bases; they die of their own degeneration at about 8:00 if neither team damages them

decisions.what: kill the sentinels at the start (opens splitting for the team, and for the enemy)
when to split depends on whether the sentinels are dead (about 8:00 if left alone)
